description: Revexa's list of startups hiring salespeople: venture-backed B2B startups (Y Combinator) with open sales roles right now (SDR, BDR, account executive, head of sales), from their public job boards. Filter by region (us, uk, europe, remote) and role type (sdr, ae, leadership). There is no country filter: each role carries its location as text, so for one country use region europe and read the role locations. The answer states the total number of matches and how many are shown. Updated weekly.

region.description: Where the role is located. europe means Europe outside the UK.

role.description: sdr = SDR/BDR, ae = account executive, leadership = head of sales, VP sales, founding seller.
